name: scrap_gun
notes: A hopper of scrap fired as a cone of nine shards. They are bodies, not rays: you can watch them go, they ricochet once off anything they clip, and they are gone less than a second out, which is what makes the gun murderous inside ten metres and useless past thirty. The right button lobs the shell whole: it bounces once, bursts, and the burst throws the hopper's own scrap out of it -- ten of the same shards, going nowhere in particular and gone in less than a second, so what the shot leaves behind it is the cone it would have fired, pointing every way at once.
